Odey Asset Management Group LTD Holds Position in Rowan Companies Plc (RDC); As Loral Space & Communicatns I (LORL) Market Value Declined, Altalis Capital Management Has Raised Its Stake by $1.55 Million 
April 23, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy 
Crispin Odey increased its stake in Rowan Companies Plc (RDC) by 93.76% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Odey Asset Management Group Ltd bought 4.91M shares as the company’s stock declined 25.51% with the market. The hedge fund run by Crispin Odey held 10.14M shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $158.79 million, up from 5.23M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Odey Asset Management Group Ltd who had been investing in Rowan Companies Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.93 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $0.11 during the last trading session, reaching $15.19. About 1.97 million shares traded. Rowan Companies plc (NYSE:RDC) has declined 22.59% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 34.14% the S&P500. 
Adam Fox increased its stake in Loral Space & Communicatns I (LORL) by 40.8% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Altalis Capital Management Llc bought 35,141 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.19% with the market. The hedge fund run by Adam Fox held 121,261 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.34 million, up from 86,120 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Altalis Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Loral Space & Communicatns I for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.24B market cap company. The stock increased 0.75% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $40.1. About 91,283 shares traded or 64.14% up from the average. Loral Space & Communications Inc. (NASDAQ:LORL) has risen 7.35% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.20% the S&P500. 
Odey Asset Management Group Ltd, which manages about $1.10B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Franco Nevada Corp (NYSE:FNV) by 10,655 shares to 194,196 shares, valued at $15.53M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (NYSE:JPM) by 3,060 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 41,940 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Since February 22, 2018, it had 0 insider buys, and 1 sale for $47,686 activity. 
Among 33 analysts covering Rowan Companies Inc. ( NYSE:RDC ), 7 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 22 Hold. Therefore 21% are positive. Rowan Companies Inc. had 103 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Friday, October 7 the stock rating was downgraded by Seaport Global Securities to “Neutral”. BMO Capital Markets maintained Rowan Companies plc (NYSE:RDC) on Monday, January 15 with “Hold” rating. Morgan Stanley upgraded the shares of RDC in report on Thursday, January 28 to “Equal-Weight” rating. Credit Agricole downgraded the stock to “Underperform” rating in Tuesday, December 22 report. On Friday, October 6 the stock rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Hold”. On Monday, May 16 the stock rating was maintained by Citigroup with “Neutral”. Guggenheim upgraded the shares of RDC in report on Monday, November 30 to “Buy” rating. Societe Generale downgraded the stock to “Sell” rating in Monday, October 3 report. On Friday, August 12 the stock rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Sector Perform”. As per Wednesday, March 9, the company rating was downgraded by Fearnley. 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.95 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.25, from 0.7 in 2017Q3.
